comment: The question the typo hints ask of a word, answered by the REAL vendored dictionary and the REAL shipped wordlist. Read by BOTH twins: tests/test_typo_hints.js puts each word through the browser composition (site/js/typo_hints.js isKnownWith over typo.js), tests/test_build_wordlist.py puts the same word through the builder's (tools/build_wordlist.py fold_word + spylls). Kept here rather than copied into each so the two cannot drift — which is exactly how a case bug once shipped that underlined 610 forms of this material's own vocabulary, unseen because the e2e serves a six-word dictionary.
